name: @hypaware/goose
description: Goose client adapter for HypAware. Reads Goose's own sessions.db read-only (LLP 0570) and materializes sessions/messages into ai_gateway_messages via the shared ai_gateway.projected_exchange materializer: a backfill provider for history and a poll source for ongoing capture. No gateway proxying, no changes to Goose.

picker.name: goose
picker.label: Goose
picker.summary: Records your Goose conversations and imports recent history. Makes no changes to Goose.
